_comment: REAL engine output only (audit remediation 2026-08-24, founder-ruled). Every snapshot here corresponds 1:1 to a line in run-archive.jsonl and was produced by the canonical doc-02 engine. The 44 pre-engine ILLUSTRATIVE SEED points that previously padded this series to 52 were pruned: they were never engine output, and a hand-edit (commit 37b23b20) had flipped synthetic_seed to false while they were still present, publishing them as measured history.
